app.title: Sudoku Solver
help.input: Use arrow keys to move. Enter a digit to jump to the next empty cell. Ctrl/Cmd+Z: Undo; Ctrl/Cmd+Y or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z: Redo.
help.puzzle_text: Enter exactly 9 lines of 9 characters. Digits 1–9 are clues; 0, ., and _ are blank cells.
message.invalid_clue_count: Enter a clue count between 17 and 81.
message.reset: Board reset to its given clues.
message.stale_solutions: These solutions are from an earlier board and cannot be applied to the current board.
worker.error.unknown_generation: The puzzle generation worker returned an unknown error.
worker.error.invalid_board: The generated board data is invalid.

message.conflicts.one: Resolve the conflict in {count} highlighted cell.

message.no_candidates.one: No candidates remain in {count} empty cell.
message.no_candidates.other: No candidates remain in {count} empty cells.

message.puzzle_loaded_conflicts.one: Puzzle loaded. Resolve the conflict in {count} highlighted cell.
message.puzzle_loaded_conflicts.other: Puzzle loaded. Resolve conflicts in {count} highlighted cells.

message.puzzle_loaded_no_candidates.one: Puzzle loaded. No candidates remain in {count} empty cell.
message.puzzle_loaded_no_candidates.other: Puzzle loaded. No candidates remain in {count} empty cells.

search.finished.solution_limit.one: At least {count} solution found; the solution limit was reached after {nodes} nodes in {seconds} s.
search.finished.solution_limit.other: At least {count} solutions found; the solution limit was reached after {nodes} nodes in {seconds} s.

search.finished.node_limit.one: Search stopped at {nodes} nodes after finding {count} solution in {seconds} s. The exact count is unknown.
search.finished.node_limit.other: Search stopped at {nodes} nodes after finding {count} solutions in {seconds} s. The exact count is unknown.

search.finished.complete.one: Search complete: exactly {count} solution found across {nodes} nodes in {seconds} s.
search.finished.complete.other: Search complete: exactly {count} solutions found across {nodes} nodes in {seconds} s.

search.cancelled.one: Search cancelled after finding {count} solution in {seconds} s.
search.cancelled.other: Search cancelled after finding {count} solutions in {seconds} s.

search.generated.one: Generated a unique puzzle with {count} clue in {seconds} s.
search.generated.other: Generated a unique puzzle with {count} clues in {seconds} s.

search.error.invalid_request: Invalid board data or search limits.
parse.invalid_character: Unsupported character at row {row}, column {column}. Use digits, 0, . or _.
